definitions.explanation: A small cube with different numbers of dots (1-6) on each face, used in games of chance. Typically thrown to generate random numbers.
Food cut into small cube shapes, resembling dice.

examples.japanese: サイコロを{振|ふ}って{出|で}た{目|め}の{数|かず}だけ{進|すす}む。
examples.english: Roll the dice and move forward by the number that comes up.

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}をサイコロ{状|じょう}に{切|き}る。
examples.english: Cut the daikon into cube shapes.

notes:
ALTERNATE WRITING:
・{骰子|さいころ} (kanji form, rarely used)
・Also written サイコロ in katakana

DICE TERMINOLOGY:
・サイコロの{目|め} (the number/pips on a die)
・{丁|ちょう} (even number total)
・{半|はん} (odd number total)
・ぞろ{目|め} (doubles)

COMMON USES:
・{双六|すごろく} (sugoroku - traditional Japanese board game)
・{人生|じんせい}ゲーム (The Game of Life)
・{麻雀|マージャン} (mahjong - for determining dealer/starting position)
・Tabletop RPGs and board games

COOKING USAGE:
・サイコロ{切|ぎ}り (diced cut)
・サイコロステーキ (cubed steak)
・サイコロ{状|じょう}に{切|き}る (to cut into cubes)

IDIOM:
・{賽|さい}は{投|な}げられた ({賽|さい} is an older word for dice) - "The die is cast"

COLLOCATIONS:
・サイコロを{振|ふ}る (to roll/throw dice)
・サイコロを{転|ころ}がす (to roll dice)
・サイコロが{出|で}る (for a number to come up)
